>>>>> "fmf" == fricano mario f <fri...@ux5.cso.uiuc.edu> writes:

fmf> I have a few questions about 1st strike. I would appreciate any help I
fmf> could get.

fmf> 1. If someone attacks with 1st strike, is range determined before
fmf> combat starts, and can both participants add manuevers or just the
fmf> attacker?

15.1. Combat Sequence

Each round of combat has the following phases:

1) Establish range by maneuver.
2) Choose strike.
3) Resolve strike.
4) Any additional strikes.
5) Press.

The acting minion always decides/declares first. The answer is that you
set up the range of the combat before first strikes occur.

fmf> 2. With the Muddled Vampire Hunter, it saids it deals 4
fmf> damage. Is that close or range?

On any card that indicates damage it will have an "R" after it if the
damage can also be done at range. Thus Muddles' damage is only close
range. Of course, if our friend Muddles has a weapon -- say an Assault
Rifle or Submachine Gun and moves to long range somehow.... Lots of first
strike damage and hopefully, muddles won't even be touched!

Messages.Author: Bob Ellison
Messages.Body:
> 1. If someone attacks with 1st strike, is range determined before
> combat starts, and can both participants add manuevers or just the attacker?

Range is always determined before combat starts. Both participants can
add maneuvers unless restricted by a special card (e.g. Drawing Out the
Beast).

> 2. With the Muddled Vampire Hunter, it saids it deals 4 damage.
> Is that close or range?

"Muddles"' damage is listed as "4 damage", which always means Close.
If Muddles could do damage at range, it would be listed as "4R damage".

Note that Muddles can be equipped with a weapon. If he is, he still
gets First Strike, but does whatever damage his weapon does.

> Also, has anyone heard anything on the new expansion set coming
> out? Is it just more clans or is it something new?

No news, sorry.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
fricano mario f <fri...@ux5.cso.uiuc.edu> writes:

> I have a few questions about 1st strike. I would appreciate any help I
>could get.

> 1. If someone attacks with 1st strike, is range determined before
>combat starts, and can both participants add manuevers or just the attacker?

Round of combat:
Choose Range (Acting Minion get first shot at maneuvering).
Acting Minion Announces Strike. (fisrt strike or normal strike).
Blocking Minion Announces Strike.
Strikes Are resolved in the following order:
Strike End combat.
Strike: dodge
Strike with First Strike
Other Strikes.

Range is never determined before combat starts, but only before strikes
are chosen.

> 2. With the Muddled Vampire Hunter, it saids it deals 4 damage.
>Is that close or range?

It doesn't say 4R, so it can't be used at long range.

Messages.Author: David Paven
Messages.Body:
L. Scott Johnson (sjoh...@math.scarolina.edu) wrote:
: fricano mario f <fri...@ux5.cso.uiuc.edu> writes:

: Round of combat:

: Choose Range (Acting Minion get first shot at maneuvering).
: Acting Minion Announces Strike. (fisrt strike or normal strike).
: Blocking Minion Announces Strike.
: Strikes Are resolved in the following order:
: Strike End combat.
: Strike: dodge
: Strike with First Strike
: Other Strikes.

No, the correct order is :

Strike End combat.
Strike with First Strike
Strike : Dodge
Other Strikes.

Dodge is a normal strike card (according to the rules) so
First Strike is resolved before.

OK, technically, the first strike resolves first.
But then the dodge resolves and negates the effect of the other strike,
be it first strike or not, so effectively the dodge resolves first [pg. 35]

see also: Design Team Ruling 12/22/94:
4) Dodge will cancel a first strike.

L. Scott Johnson
